summary_bullets: Prove Step 0b recovery is bypassed when write-run-params.sh fails hard
Add write_then_recover() helper and cases 7/7b to the router-flag recovery harness
Document writer-failure abort coverage for OOS #3161 in the harness sibling doc
commit_message:
Close #3161: prove Step 0b recovery bypass on writer failure

Add write_then_recover() and cases 7/7b to test-step0b-router-flag-recovery.sh:
case 7 asserts invalid --classification aborts before recovery; case 7b is the
positive control that recovery still completes on success. Update the harness doc.
